en_title: One of GTA 6's Best Features Was Actually Planned for GTA: Vice City, Reveals Ex-Rockstar Dev
cn_title: 前Rockstar开发者透露，《GTA 6》最出色的功能之一其实曾计划加入《GTA: Vice City》
opus_summary: 前Rockstar开发者Obbe Vermeji透露，《GTA 6》的耳机功能原本计划加入《GTA: Vice City》，还曾为其制作图标，但因技术原因被砍。该功能在《GTA 6》中让玩家能够随时收听音乐、播客和电台节目。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's headphones mechanic was originally planned to be included in the original GTA: Vice City, according to a former Rockstar Games employee.
paragraphs.cn: 据一名前Rockstar员工透露，《GTA 6》的耳机机制最初曾计划加入原版《GTA: Vice City》。

paragraphs.en: Ex-Rockstar Games dev Obbe Vermeji revealed that the headphones feature was cut from GTA: Vice City due to a technical reason, and they had even created an icon for it. It's unclear what the technical reason was, but Vice City's version likely would've come in the form of a Walkman or cassette player, given it was set in the 80s. GTA 6's version, however, comes with a smartphone and a pair of AirPods.
paragraphs.cn: 前Rockstar开发者Obbe Vermeji透露，耳机功能因为一个技术原因从《GTA: Vice City》中被删去，而他们甚至已经为该功能制作了一个图标。目前尚不清楚具体的技术原因是什么，但考虑到《GTA: Vice City》的背景设定在80年代，其版本很可能会以随身听或磁带播放器的形式出现。而《GTA 6》的版本则配有一部智能手机和一副AirPods。

paragraphs.en: The feature is pretty incredible, because you can listen to music and podcasts wherever you go. You no longer have to sit in the car to finish a song; you can just get out, put your headphones in, and turn on the radio station you were just listening to. And when combined with combat encounters, it can have some thrilling results. Last night, In the Air Tonight came on as I approached a gang hideout, creating an incredibly cinematic moment for me.
paragraphs.cn: 这个功能相当了不起，因为无论走到哪里，你都可以听音乐和播客。你不再需要坐在车里听完一首歌；你可以直接下车，戴上耳机，打开刚才正在收听的电台。而当它与战斗遭遇相结合时，还能产生一些令人兴奋的效果。昨晚，我接近一个帮派藏身处时，《In the Air Tonight》响了起来，为我带来了一个极具电影感的时刻。

paragraphs.en: It doesn't always have to lead to some epic moment, though. It's great for working out in-game, learning about the world and lore of GTA via podcasts and talk shows, and much more. A lot of effort has been packed into creating GTA 6's in-game media, and the headphones allow you to make full use of it. The only downside is that you can't make any kind of custom playlists. Presumably, this is because Rockstar wants players to organically discover music from the radio stations instead of curating the songs they already know and love.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，它不一定总要带来什么史诗般的时刻。它非常适合在游戏中锻炼、通过播客和脱口秀了解《侠盗猎车手》的世界及背景故事，还有许多其他用途。《GTA 6》游戏内的媒体内容倾注了大量心血，而耳机让你能够充分利用这些内容。唯一的缺点是，你无法创建任何自定义播放列表。据推测，这是因为Rockstar希望玩家自然地从电台中发现音乐，而不是整理自己已经熟悉和喜爱的歌曲。

paragraphs.en: The option would be nice, but personally, there are so many great songs I may have never heard if GTA's radio stations didn't expose me to them. Maybe a future update or the inevitable online mode will include a playlist option, but it could be a while before we see such a thing.
paragraphs.cn: 有这个选项当然不错，但就我个人而言，如果不是《侠盗猎车手》的电台让我接触到那么多好歌，我可能永远都不会听到它们。也许未来的更新或不可避免会推出的在线模式会加入播放列表选项，但我们可能还要等上一段时间才能看到这样的功能。
